register.source_checks: The author reports that his two exact rational checkers, verify_cert.py and verify_cert2.py, accept the certificate, with least pair separation 1.2e-12 and least wall clearance 6.0e-13. The source states the certificate is a dilation of a binary64 packing (search/packer/dilate_cert.py): centres and box scaled by 1 + 10^-12, coordinates rounded to rationals and each angle to a rational half-angle tangent, so every square is exactly unit; it certifies the upper bound only. The source calls it a nearby configuration of the opening certificate's packing, with the same tilted structure. No source program ran here.
